## fc999420d3aa

**Reproduced domain/override defect.** The generator summary promises distinct
colors for separate target motifs, but a deterministic 600-grid census
(seed expression `810000 + index`, 200 indices per band) found 182 of 485
multi-target grids with repeated target colors. The first case is easy index 27:
both completable pluses are color 3, and `self_check` returns no error. The same
probe also shows that advertised controls `n_motifs`, `n_decoys`, and
`palette_kind` accept contrasting values but return byte-identical grids at
seed 12345/sample 67, so those exact controls are not honored.

Evidence: `checks/audit/fc999420d3aa/override-and-color-domain.json` (generator
SHA-256 `a408dea72c0fdc80b719e5a44d1d0ccac8f3638d2c37d9a49cb8bf13eb909383`).
The target source was inspected only and left unchanged. A repair should either
enforce unique target colors and consume the advertised controls, or narrow the
summary/axis contract and validator to the behavior actually supported.
